title: Resolve planning identities
responsibility: Find a plan folder by unit identity and verify its relationship to a canonical unit manifest.

inputs.name: validateIdentity.git
inputs.description: Repository handle whose `run` command runner reads the revision's trees and blobs with `git ls-tree` and `git show`; this unit uses only `run`, not `root` or `dir`. A Git command that exits non-zero rejects with an Error whose code is git-failed, and one that cannot start rejects with its system error.

inputs.name: validateIdentity.rev
inputs.description: Revision whose canonical manifest is read through attest when unitId differs from `<category>.<slug>`; the plan folder itself is not read from Git, and the value is passed to Git without validation.

inputs.name: validateIdentity.plan
inputs.description: PlanSummary to verify: only `unitId`, `category`, `slug` and `path` are read, and `path` must equal the folder derived from `<category>.<slug>`, for example `src/components/evidence-grid`. The other fields are ignored.

examples.title: Evidence grid
examples.goal: Show evidence rows with their status and source link.

contract.responsibility: Render evidence rows with their status and source link.

examples.title: Evidence grid
examples.goal: Show evidence rows for a report with status and source link.

contract.responsibility: Render report evidence rows with their status and source link.

inputs.name: identity.unitId
inputs.description: Dotted lowercase unit ID of at most 200 characters with at least two segments that each start with a letter and contain only letters, digits and hyphens, such as `reports.component.evidence-grid`. Values that fail the artifact filename rule (lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens only, starting with a letter or digit, and no `..`) are refused as unsafe-path, and other invalid values as invalid-input.

inputs.name: attest.git
inputs.description: Repository handle whose `run` command runner reads the revision's trees and blobs with `git ls-tree` and `git show`; this unit uses only `run`, not `root` or `dir`. A Git command that exits non-zero rejects with an Error whose code is git-failed, and one that cannot start rejects with its system error.

inputs.name: attest.rev
inputs.description: Revision whose `specification/units/<unitId>.json` manifest is read; the value is passed to Git without validation.

inputs.name: attest.unit
inputs.description: Unit ID and category that the canonical manifest must match: its `id` must equal `unitId` and its `kind` must equal `category`, and `unitId` is checked by the identity rules first.

inputs.name: planFiles.git
inputs.description: Repository handle whose `run` command runner reads the revision's trees and blobs with `git ls-tree` and `git show`; this unit uses only `run`, not `root` or `dir`. A Git command that exits non-zero rejects with an Error whose code is git-failed, and one that cannot start rejects with its system error.

inputs.name: planFiles.rev
inputs.description: Revision whose src tree is listed with `git ls-tree -rz`; the value is passed to Git without validation.

inputs.name: findIdentity.git
inputs.description: Repository handle whose `run` command runner reads the revision's trees and blobs with `git ls-tree` and `git show`; this unit uses only `run`, not `root` or `dir`. A Git command that exits non-zero rejects with an Error whose code is git-failed, and one that cannot start rejects with its system error.

inputs.name: findIdentity.rev
inputs.description: Revision whose plan.json files are listed under src and read to find the unit; the value is passed to Git without validation.

inputs.name: findIdentity.unitId
inputs.description: Unit ID to locate: it is checked by the identity rules first, then compared with the `unitId` of each plan.json that planFiles lists. plan.json files that cannot be read or parsed are skipped rather than matched.

inputs.name: planIdentity.git
inputs.description: Repository handle whose `run` command runner reads the revision's trees and blobs with `git ls-tree` and `git show`; this unit uses only `run`, not `root` or `dir`. A Git command that exits non-zero rejects with an Error whose code is git-failed, and one that cannot start rejects with its system error.

inputs.name: planIdentity.rev
inputs.description: Revision searched for the unit's plan; the value is passed unchanged to findIdentity.

inputs.name: planIdentity.unitId
inputs.description: Unit ID that must match exactly one plan.json at the revision: zero matches reject with not-found and two or more reject with artifact-tampered.

outputs.name: identity
outputs.description: Returns nothing when the unit ID passes the artifact filename rule and the dotted identity rule; otherwise it throws.

outputs.name: attest
outputs.description: Resolves with nothing when the manifest's `id` equals `unitId` and its `kind` equals `category`; otherwise it rejects.

outputs.name: planFiles
outputs.description: Resolves with the repository paths `src/<folder>/<name>/plan.json`, where folder is pages, shells, layouts, components, functions, configs or services; every other path under src is dropped.

outputs.name: findIdentity
outputs.description: Resolves with the plan folder (the matching plan.json path without its `/plan.json` suffix), or null when no plan has the unit ID; two or more matches reject with artifact-tampered.

outputs.name: planIdentity
outputs.description: Resolves with the plan folder of the unit; when findIdentity resolves null it rejects with not-found.

outputs.name: validateIdentity
outputs.description: Resolves with nothing when the unit ID is valid, `plan.path` is the folder derived from `<category>.<slug>`, and, when `unitId` differs from `<category>.<slug>`, the canonical manifest matches the unit; otherwise it rejects.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The value thrown or rejected is a plain Error, not an ExpectedCliError instance, whose `code` is one of invalid-input, unsafe-path, artifact-tampered, artifact-missing, artifact-corrupt, not-found or git-failed. It is raised for an invalid unit ID, a plan folder or manifest that does not match, a missing, unparseable or non-regular artifact, duplicate plan identities, a unit with no plan, or a Git runner failure; a manifest whose JSON is null makes reading its id throw a TypeError.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects with a plain Error whose `code` is invalid-input for an invalid unit ID, category or slug or for a manifest whose id or kind differs, unsafe-path for a unit ID that fails the artifact filename rule or for a manifest that is not a regular file, artifact-tampered when `plan.path` is not the derived folder, artifact-missing or artifact-corrupt for an absent or unparseable manifest, or a Git runner error (git-failed when git exits non-zero). A manifest whose JSON is null makes reading its id throw a TypeError.

inputs.name: identity.unitId
inputs.description: Dotted lowercase unit ID of at most 200 characters with at least two segments that each start with a letter and contain only letters, digits and hyphens, such as `reports.component.evidence-grid`. Values that fail the artifact filename rule (lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens only, starting with a letter or digit, and no `..`) are refused as unsafe-path, and other invalid values as invalid-input.

outputs.name: identity
outputs.description: Returns nothing when the unit ID passes the artifact filename rule and the dotted identity rule; otherwise it throws.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Throws a plain Error whose `code` is unsafe-path when the unit ID fails the artifact filename rule, and invalid-input when it is longer than 200 characters or does not have at least two dot-separated segments that each start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

inputs.name: attest.git
inputs.description: Repository handle whose `run` command runner reads the revision's trees and blobs with `git ls-tree` and `git show`; this unit uses only `run`, not `root` or `dir`. A Git command that exits non-zero rejects with an Error whose code is git-failed, and one that cannot start rejects with its system error.

inputs.name: attest.rev
inputs.description: Revision whose `specification/units/<unitId>.json` manifest is read; the value is passed to Git without validation.

inputs.name: attest.unit
inputs.description: Unit ID and category that the canonical manifest must match: its `id` must equal `unitId` and its `kind` must equal `category`, and `unitId` is checked by the identity rules first.

outputs.name: attest
outputs.description: Resolves with nothing when the manifest's `id` equals `unitId` and its `kind` equals `category`; otherwise it rejects.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects with a plain Error whose `code` is unsafe-path or invalid-input when the unit ID fails the identity rules, invalid-input when the manifest's id or kind differs from the unit, artifact-missing when `specification/units/<unitId>.json` is absent, unsafe-path when that entry is not a regular file (mode other than 100644 or 100755), artifact-corrupt when it is not valid JSON, or a Git runner error (git-failed when git exits non-zero). A manifest whose JSON is null makes reading its id throw a TypeError.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects only with the Git runner's error: code git-failed when the `git ls-tree -rz` listing of src exits non-zero, or a system error when git cannot start; the function raises no error of its own.

errors.description: Rejects with a plain Error whose `code` is unsafe-path or invalid-input for a unit ID that fails the identity rules, artifact-tampered when two or more plan.json files carry the unit ID, or a Git runner error from listing src. plan.json files that cannot be read or parsed are skipped without raising an error.

inputs.description: Repository handle whose `run` command runner reads the revision's trees and blobs with `git ls-tree` and `git show`; this unit uses only `run`, not `root` or `dir`. A Git command that exits non-zero rejects with an Error whose code is git-failed, and one that cannot start rejects with its system error.

outputs.description: Resolves with the plan folder of the unit; when findIdentity resolves null it rejects with not-found.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects with a plain Error whose `code` is not-found when findIdentity resolves null; otherwise it rejects with findIdentity's errors: unsafe-path or invalid-input for a unit ID that fails the identity rules, artifact-tampered for duplicate plans, and Git runner errors from listing src.
